_comment: Tuned on Xense/newbalance_shoe_insole_retrieval_and_packing_0611 ep0. The two arms alternate take-outs: shoes 1-2 are lifted by the RIGHT arm (tcp 9,10,11 / grip 19) from the box at negative y (~-0.35); shoes 3-4 by the LEFT arm (tcp 0,1,2 / grip 18) from the box at positive y (~+0.30). Both source boxes are at high x (~1.0-1.25). Verified pick times: 4.7s / 122.6s / 234.6s / 407.0s (ground truth 1-5 / 115-125 / 225-240 / 390-410s). blue.roi = middle columns / upper rows where the gripper presents the insole to the head cam; blue HSV sampled from the insole (H~95-120, S~220, V~175); area ~0.16 when the blue underside is up vs ~0.01 absent, so min_area_frac=0.05.
_present_poses_note: LEFT-arm 9-D pose (xyz + 6-D rot = state[0:9]) held at the insole show-to-camera instant, RE-CALIBRATED on the on-site robot from dewu_debug_20260704_175421 (shoe1 f662-849 z+0.06, shoe2 f2689-2889 z+0.08, shoe3 f5076-5157 z-0.19; shoe4 not captured that run -> reuse shoe3, same group). Two-stage gate: (1) the pose gate is the PRIMARY discriminator — the insole GRAB pose (z ~ -0.34..-0.42) sits ~1.5-2.0 away, so tol 0.6 matches ONLY the held presentation and never the grab (this is what killed the arm-side blue false positives, which all fired during the grab). (2) pose_require_blue=true then double-checks the blue vision at that held pose: the insole fills the ROI when shown to the head cam (verified f690 ~33%+), so blue confirms the insole is really there. Because the blue check runs ONLY while the presentation pose is held, the arm-body-reads-as-blue problem is moot (that happens at the grab pose, which the pose gate already rejects).
